Description.description: One file the BFF stores outside document management: a Procedure Version's source, an invoice PDF or supporting file, or an export file. Bytes live in Blob storage at {tenant}/{parent table}/{parent id}/{file id}; this row is the file's authority (purpose, status, parent, source ids, hashes). Written only by the BFF (ebilling-r1 task 088, model 4.1).
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
Owner Id
Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.

Parent, for an export file. Exactly one parent lookup is set on a row (enforced by the BFF, task 090). REMOVELINK: an export deleted outside the BFF leaves the row for the orphan reconcile (model 4.2, 10). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

Server-only: {tenantId}/{parent table}/{parent id}/{file id}. The download checks that its parent id equals the row's parent (model 4.1, 4.2). Readable and writable only by the BFF (field-secured, no reader row).
MIME content type of the stored file. Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

The PERSON who asked for this file. Stamped by the BFF only (field-secured later by task 086): createdby is the BFF application user for a row the BFF creates app-only, so this column is what records the person. ebilling-r1 task 088 (O-23; the Deploy-EbillingSubmissionSchema.ps1 shape).

Not yet servable (staged, or committed but not yet re-checked), Servable, or Removed. Every reader refuses a row that is not Servable (model 4.1, 9.1 steps 4-6). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

Not yet servable (staged, or committed but not yet re-checked), Servable, or Removed. Every reader refuses a row that is not Servable (model 4.1, 9.1 steps 4-6). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

Yes only for an invoice PDF the firm uploaded through the SPA; a Submit Invoice copy, a supporting file, a Procedure file and an export file are always No (uac-r2 F1-d). The firm file route serves only Invoice PDF + Firm-visible + Servable. Written only by the BFF (field-secured). Default No.

Yes only for an invoice PDF the firm uploaded through the SPA; a Submit Invoice copy, a supporting file, a Procedure file and an export file are always No (uac-r2 F1-d). The firm file route serves only Invoice PDF + Firm-visible + Servable. Written only by the BFF (field-secured). Default No.

Parent, for an invoice PDF or supporting file. Exactly one parent lookup is set on a row (enforced by the BFF, task 090). REMOVELINK: an invoice deleted outside the BFF leaves the row for the orphan reconcile (model 4.2). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
The file name.

Parent, for a Procedure source file. Exactly one parent lookup is set on a row (enforced by the BFF, task 090). REMOVELINK: a Procedure Version deleted outside the BFF leaves the row for the orphan reconcile, which reads the parent from the blob path (model 4.2). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
Procedure source, Invoice PDF, Invoice supporting file or Export file. Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
SHA-256 of the stored blob (hex). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
Size of the stored file in bytes, 0 to 2147483647 (a larger file cannot be stored; the BFF refuses it, task 090). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

For a Submit Invoice copy: the marked attachment's identity inside the source (the .eml's MIME part: ordinal, name; model 9.1 step 3). Never an Exchange item id. Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

For a Submit Invoice copy: the email (communication) the file came from (model 9.1). RESTRICT: a referenced communication cannot be deleted; a communication delete only deactivates it, so the copy rule still reads it (uac-r2 answer B). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

For a Submit Invoice copy: the Document the bytes were copied from (the .eml for an Outlook add-in submission). The copy rule reads the caller's own Read on it on every access (model 9.1, B). RESTRICT: a referenced document cannot be deleted (uac-r2 answer B). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
SHA-256 of the source bytes at staging (hex), checked again by the flip to Servable (uac-r2 F2-1). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).

The source document's version number at staging, as ONE canonical string (invariant culture, no padding, no separators; task 090); the commit's IfRowVersionMatches guard pins it (uac-r2 F2-c). Written only by the BFF (field-secured).
